item.title: Arkansas State Police traffic stop leads to cocaine seizure, federal charges, prison for Dominican man
item.description: A 60-year-old man from the Dominican Republic was sentenced to 70 months in federal prison for possession with intent to distribute cocaine after being pulled over by Arkansas State Police in 2024.
